words.example: Initiated by the China International Communications Group in 2022, the Orchid Awards honor non-Chinese individuals and institutions for promoting cultural exchanges and mutual learning between China and the rest of the world.
words.exampleCn: 由中国国际传播集团在2022年发起,兰花奖旨在表彰非中国个人和机构在促进中国与世界其他国家文化交流与相互学习方面的贡献.

words.example: The Lifetime Honorary Award was given to Nobel laureate Jean-Marie Gustave Le Clezio from France, for "devoting his life to overcoming barriers and understanding others".
words.exampleCn: 终身荣誉奖授予了来自法国的诺贝尔奖得主让-马里·古斯塔夫·勒克留佐,以表彰他“毕生致力于打破障碍和理解他人”.

words.example: In his acceptance speech, Le Clezio said that it is "a great honor", "a great privilege" and "a great accomplishment" for him to receive the award, "because I feel a sincere connection with the people of China, the proximity of spirit with the Chinese culture, and especially the taste for Chinese literature".
words.exampleCn: 在获奖感言中,勒克留佐表示,获得该奖项对他而言是“莫大的荣幸”、“巨大的特权”和“伟大的成就”,“因为我觉得与中国民众有着真诚的联系,与中国文化在精神上有着亲近感,尤其是对中国文学有着品味”.

words.example: Recipients of the Friendship Envoy Award included Fausto Giunchiglia from Italy, Hasan Capan from Turkiye, Jad Tabet from Lebanon/France, Luminita Balan from Romania, Adam Foster from the United States and Chea Munyrith from Cambodia.

words.example: Foster, founder and chair emeritus of the Helen Foster Snow Foundation, received the Friendship Envoy Award because by "carrying forward Helen Foster Snow's enduring bond with China, he has transformed a family legacy into friendship across generations".

words.example: In his speech, Foster said that compared with nearly 90 years ago, when Helen Foster Snow traveled from Utah in the US to China as a young journalist seeking to understand a people and culture very different from her own, today people in the two countries have instant access to more information, however, with more information people may understand each other less.
words.exampleCn: 福斯特在演讲中说,与近90年前相比,当时海伦·福斯特·斯诺作为一名年轻的记者从美国犹他州前往中国,试图理解一个与她自己非常不同的民族和文化,如今两国人民可以即时获取更多信息,然而,信息越多,人们可能相互理解得越少.

words.example: It is easy to see another country through headlines, politics, stereotypes or disagreements.
